pr.title: Refactor physics step into integrate(); tune jump feel

reason: The pinned behaviour horizontal-movement-air-control-reduces-acceleration held on base, fails on head, and the pull request does not announce it.

intent.summary: Refactors the physics step into an integrate() function and adjusts jump-related parameters for better feel.
intended_changes: The physics step is now handled by a new integrate() function that encapsulates velocity and collision logic.
Coyote time is increased from 4 to 6 frames to prevent missed jumps near platform edges.
Terminal fall speed is raised from 18 to 22 to make landings feel snappier and reduce floatiness on long drops.

data.title: Refactor physics step into integrate(); tune jump feel

data.summary: Refactors the physics step into an integrate() function and adjusts jump-related parameters for better feel.
intended_changes: The physics step is now handled by a new integrate() function that encapsulates velocity and collision logic.
Coyote time is increased from 4 to 6 frames to prevent missed jumps near platform edges.
Terminal fall speed is raised from 18 to 22 to make landings feel snappier and reduce floatiness on long drops.

data.name: grounded-jumps-set-airframes-to-coyote-frames-plus-one
data.claim: When a jump occurs while grounded, the resulting state has airFrames set to COYOTE_FRAMES + 1.

data.name: not-grounded-no-jump-increments-airframes
data.claim: When not grounded and not jumping, airFrames increments by 1 each frame.

data.name: landing-resets-airframes-to-zero
data.claim: When landing (moving downward and hitting a platform), airFrames is reset to 0.

data.name: coyote-time-allows-jump-after-ledge
data.claim: After walking off a ledge, a jump can still be executed for COYOTE_FRAMES frames due to coyote time.

data.name: jump-buffer-queues-jump-press
data.claim: A jump press is buffered for JUMP_BUFFER_FRAMES frames, allowing a jump to execute shortly after the press even if not grounded at the exact frame.

data.name: horizontal-movement-ground-friction-applies-when-held
data.claim: When grounded and a horizontal direction is held, velocity is multiplied by RUN_FRICTION each frame.

data.name: horizontal-movement-stop-friction-when-not-held
data.claim: When grounded and no horizontal direction is held, velocity is multiplied by STOP_FRICTION each frame.

data.name: horizontal-movement-air-control-reduces-acceleration
data.claim: When in the air, horizontal acceleration is reduced to RUN_ACCEL * AIR_CONTROL.

data.name: vertical-velocity-respects-terminal-speed
data.claim: Vertical velocity is clamped to -TERMINAL_SPEED when falling.

data.name: horizontal-speed-is-clamped-to-max-run-speed
data.claim: Horizontal speed is clamped to MAX_RUN_SPEED when acceleration would exceed it.

data.name: jump-overrides-vertical-velocity
data.claim: When a jump occurs, the vertical velocity is set exactly to JUMP_SPEED, ignoring current velocity or gravity.
